tools.name: list_supported_formats
tools.description: Which formats, profiles and rule sets this service supports, and what each tool costs.

tools.name: detect_invoice
tools.description: Identify the format, syntax, profile/customization and country standard of an e-invoice file. Cheap first step before validating.

tools.name: parse_invoice
tools.description: Extract the invoice as normalised JSON: number, dates, seller, buyer, lines, VAT breakdown, totals, payment details. Works for every supported format.

tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Run the official rule set for the detected format (KoSIT for XRechnung/ZUGFeRD/Factur-X, OpenPeppol for Peppol BIS, FA(3) schema for KSeF). Returns valid/invalid with every failed rule: id, severity, message, XPath.

tools.name: render_invoice_html
tools.description: Human-readable invoice document (HTML, A4 print layout) from the XML, in the requested language.

tools.name: render_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Human-readable PDF of the invoice (counts as 2 requests). Returned as a base64 resource.

tools.name: my_usage
tools.description: Plan, monthly quota, usage this month and subscription state of the API key used for this connection. Free.
